title: Limited independence
statement: Let $\mu$ be a probability distribution on Boolean assignments to $n$ variables, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The distribution is $k$-wise independent if, for every set $S$ of variables with $|S|\le k$, the restriction of a random assignment drawn from $\mu$ to $S$ is uniformly distributed over all Boolean assignments to $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution on Boolean assignments to $n$ variables
